meta.rule: Irregularities and unverified items are published here with sources. None of these block publication.

items.title: No Venetian event is officially single-entry (yet)
items.detail: All 37 official DSE IV structure sheets were read line-by-line. None states a maximum number of entries, 'no re-entry', 'freezeout', or any add-on policy. Sheet 8 (Events 18/58) prints "All subsequent buy in's after the initial buy in will be $200", implying re-entry is allowed there, and every multi-flight sheet prints "Any player who bags chips for Day 2 may not play a subsequent flight", implying re-entry into later flights is otherwise permitted. Per the site rules, no event is labeled confirmed single-entry without explicit wording.
items.action: Ask the Venetian poker room (or check registration terms) for written single-entry/no-re-entry policy per event before paying non-refundable travel.

items.title: All Wynn daily tournaments officially allow re-entry and/or add-ons
items.detail: Official structures PDF: Mon-Thu $200 and Nightly $160 print re-entry explicitly ('entry fee, as well as the re-entry fee, is ...'); Sat/Sun $200 allows re-entries + one $100 add-on; Friday $240 is a rebuy/add-on event with unlimited rebuys (re-entry explicitly NOT allowed). None qualifies as a single-entry event.

items.title: Wynn dailies may be suspended during the WPT series
items.detail: Each Wynn daily structure states the event 'may be suspended during Seniors Events, Classic Events, or other Tournament Series.' During the WPT World Championship (Nov 27 - Dec 21), the usual dailies may not run as printed.
items.action: Confirm the daily calendar for your exact dates on wynnpoker.com before booking.

items.title: Official WPT schedule PDF prints impossible weekday: 'Dec. 18 Wednesday'
items.detail: Six schedule rows (incl. $1,100 NLH $1M GTD Day 1A/1B, $800 PLO Double Board Bomb Pot, PLO 6-Max, HORSE, two satellite rows) are printed under 'Dec. 18 Wednesday'. In 2026, December 18 is a Friday and December 16 is the Wednesday. The adjacent rows print 'Dec. 17 Thursday' and 'Dec. 18 Friday' correctly. The dates for the mislabeled rows are ambiguous as printed and are NOT guessed on this site.
items.action: Verify intended dates with the Wynn poker room before registering.

items.title: Four Venetian events list no guarantee anywhere
items.detail: Events #3, #4, #5 ($200 NLH RaceDay Stack, structure sheet 18) and #6 ($200 NLH 1Day, structure sheet 29) print no guarantee on their sheets, and the schedule page shows none for them. Guarantee fields are left blank and these rows are excluded from ratio ranking.

items.title: Bounty-event guarantees include bounty money
items.detail: Venetian bounty sheets print the guarantee as 'prize pool + total bounties' (e.g., $8,000 for $200 bounties, $15,000 for $300 bounties). The displayed ratio (guarantee / buy-in) therefore mixes bounty and prize-pool money; bounty rows are labeled and ranked separately.

items.title: WPT structures PDF chunks 4-7 not yet read line-by-line
items.detail: Structures for $1,600 NLH $1M, WPT Prime $5M, Super Gold Million Mystery Bounty $400 $3M, $800 NLH $500K, $1,600 PLO $1M, Seniors, $3,000 NLH $2M, $1,100 NLH $1M, $1,600 Mystery Bounty, high rollers, Ladies, and remaining satellites were not read in this pass (chunks 0-3 of 8 were). Their re-entry rules are marked unverified. Every event whose structure WAS read states 'Unlimited re-entry ... until the start of level 9.'
items.action: Read remaining chunks before relying on re-entry policy for those events.

items.title: Hotel room rates cannot be statically verified
items.detail: Strip hotels publish rates through dynamic booking engines (dates/occupancy-specific). No durable official static rate page exists. Room-rate fields are left blank; the site provides official booking links and a dated rate log. Logged dated items so far: Venetian resort fee $55/night + tax (official page, 2026-11-16); Venetian conditional poker-rate program $119/$209 starts (official suite-rates page, session 60fb62da); TI optional resort fee $49.95 + tax (official TI pages, session 60fb62da); TI "$69 NIGHT + NO RESORT FEE" package headline (official homepage, 2026-11-17; footnotes not visible in extract).
items.action: Capture itemized checkout totals for exact dates/occupancy from the official booking engine and append to the rate log before paying.

items.title: 13.38% room-tax rate is corroborated but not yet independently re-verified this session
items.detail: The calculator applies 13.38% because the site owner specified it. The shared board records that session 60fb62da verified 13.38% Clark County room tax from official Treasure Island offer-terms pages (2026-11-16); no official government page was reachable from this session's build environment to re-confirm.
items.action: Verify the tax line on your actual booking checkout (it is printed there) and correct the constant in app.js if it differs.

items.title: Walking minutes are mapping estimates — no property publishes official walk times
items.detail: Each hotel-venue row links Google Maps directions between the two official properties and shows a straight-line-distance-based estimate. No casino publishes an official walking-time figure. The ≤30-minute walk filter applies to these labeled estimates only.
items.action: Open the Maps links and confirm a route you would actually walk, at the time of day you would walk it.

items.title: Caesars / Bellagio / ARIA official pages unreachable from the build environment
items.detail: caesars.com and mgmresorts.com pages did not load during this build (consistent with earlier sessions). Those rooms' tournaments are listed on this site only as pointers to their official pages, without values.

items.title: No 8:00 AM start exists on any official schedule checked
items.detail: The requested 8 AM day-start cannot be met officially: earliest Venetian starts are 9:10 AM (Turbo satellite #46) and 10:10 AM (RaceDay/Seniors/1A flights); Wynn dailies start at 12 PM and WPT morning flights at 10-11 AM. The schedule page builds the earliest possible day honestly instead of inventing an 8 AM event.

items.title: Official-page typos preserved, not corrected
items.detail: Venetian schedule page prints 'No LImit Hold'em' for events 2, 6, 10, 12; Wynn daily poster headline pairs are read from a two-column layout. Site rows use the official text; where layout pairing was ambiguous, the structures PDF (which is definitive) was used.

items.title: Eligibility restrictions apply to some events
items.detail: Venetian Seniors events (#24, #32, #49) require age 50+; LIPS Ladies events require female players; the LIPS tag team event requires teams; Wynn/WPT requires 21+ and venue rewards membership (Venetian Rewards card printed on every Venetian sheet; Wynn Rewards membership printed in Wynn terms).

items.title: Discounted buy-ins exist and change the true entry cost
items.detail: Official discounts printed: Venetian Event #59 1A pre-registration $20 off ($580), Event #56 1A/1B pre-registration $40 off ($1,060), PokerAtlas PRO $20 off first entry of Events 18/58 ($180), WPT pre-registration discount footnote (*****), Ladies Championship $11,100 entry with ladies discount. The table shows the standard buy-in; discounts are in each row's notes.
